originality.rationale: The accessible full relevant sections of Jana–Pal–Roy describe Banach Wold/BCL Toeplitz modeling but do not provide the stated all-exponent, all-positive-lag norming-vector classification. Classical Clarkson work supplies the sharp scalar bounds and scalar equality cases; these are credited, not claimed. The new combined statement identifies every norming sequence for a delayed complementary projection pair and its exact geometric phase transition, plus commuting-factor product identity. Public research-record searches and the accessible own ledger found no exact equivalent. Remaining risk: this particular consequence may have appeared implicitly in older Haar/polyphase norm discussions or in a complete treatment of generalized Clarkson inequalities.

value.rationale: This is a complete optimal-norm and complete norming-vector classification for the simplest bicontractive BCL-type two-channel Toeplitz splitting, valid at every exponent and power, including a genuine p=2 phase change in all norming support patterns. It quantifies precisely why two norm-one complementary coefficient projections may yield noncontractive commuting shift factors whose product remains isometric. The geometry and iff norming structure, not merely reuse of scalar Clarkson constants, supply the motivated mathematical content.
